Hello Marc.  It was such a pleasure meeting with you, and we really enjoyed being introduced to Harper — what an innovative concept!  At this point, though, we’re in a cost-containment mode and don’t have the resources to take on new implementations. While we see the value in what Wisq offers, it’s just not the right time for us.
We truly appreciate the conversation and wish you continued success.
Best,
Erin
